description: This file defines types, structures, macros, and function prototypes for a State Machine Engine used in a voice SDK. It includes state and event management, state transition logic, and debug support.

methods.name: SmInit
methods.description: Initializes the state machine with an initial state.

methods.name: SmEnqueueEvent
methods.description: Adds an event to the state machine's event queue.

methods.name: SmInThisState
methods.description: Checks if the state machine is currently in a specified state.

methods.name: SmSetThisState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the state machine.

methods.name: SmProcessEvents
methods.description: Processes queued events and manages state transitions.
